title: GHAgentCI: A Dataset of Coding-Agent Invocations in CI Workflow Histories
abstract: arXiv:2611.15522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into GitHub Actions to review pull requests, triage issues and modify code. Identifying these integrations is challenging because agentic workflows often resemble ordinary CI files, with evidence appearing in action references, shell commands and workflow conventions. We present GHAgentCI, a dataset of 15K+ workflow histories from 6K+ of 196K+ mined GitHub repositories, comprising 159K+ revisions and 205K+ agent-evidence records linked to workflow triggers and declared execution constraints. Our open-source extractor, cai-miner, detects agent-related evidence using an extensible catalogue. Manual validation of 576 stratified records confirmed 96.1% of dedicated-action matches and 98.8% of GitHub Agentic Workflow matches, with lower rates for other evidence kinds. Exploratory analyses reveal a shift toward command-line and GitHub Agentic Workflow integrations, differences in declared safeguards,

translated_title: GHAgentCI：CI工作流历史中编码智能体调用数据集
translated_abstract: 编码智能体正日益被集成到GitHub Actions中，用于审查拉取请求、分类问题和修改代码。识别这些集成具有挑战性，因为智能体工作流通常与普通CI文件极为相似，其证据分散出现在动作引用、shell命令和工作流约定中。我们提出了GHAgentCI数据集，包含从196K+个挖掘的GitHub仓库中6K+个仓库的15K+个工作流历史，涵盖159K+个修订版本和205K+条智能体证据记录，这些记录与工作流触发器及声明的执行约束相关联。我们的开源提取器cai-miner通过可扩展的规则目录来检测与智能体相关的证据。对576条分层记录的人工验证确认了专用动作匹配的准确率达96.1%、GitHub智能体工作流匹配的准确率达98.8%，其他证据类型的匹配率较低。探索性分析揭示了集成方式向命令行和GitHub智能体工作流的转变，以及各仓库在声明安全防护措施方面的差异。
tldr: 本文构建了GHAgentCI数据集，包含15K+个CI工作流历史和205K+条智能体证据记录，并开发了开源提取工具cai-miner，首次系统性地从GitHub Actions工作流中识别和检测编码智能体的集成使用。
en_tdlr: We present GHAgentCI, a dataset of 15K+ CI workflow histories with 205K+ agent-evidence records, together with the open-source extractor cai-miner, enabling systematic detection of coding-agent integrations in GitHub Actions workflows.
